evidence.title: Writer operation p99
evidence.scope: Exact deployment target, log namespace and ID; mapped node/path for node metrics; reader identity where applicable.
evidence.preconditions: The source is reachable, the target series are present, and the selected window has enough valid samples.
evidence.rule: With at least 100 observations in each evaluated 1-minute interval, p99 exceeds the configured 100 ms reference for 3 consecutive minutes. This is an illustrative threshold, not a universal SLO.
evidence.limits: Writer API timing only; select write and write_async separately. It is not the Milvus SDK request latency.
evidence.availability: Existing metric; verify deployed version and label availability.
evidence.owner: diagnostics/wal (rules); diagnostics/prometheus (source client and quality gates)

evidence.title: Failed Writer operations

evidence.rule: A positive increase in the error observation count indicates instrumented failed calls.
evidence.limits: Counts instrumented errors only; some early returns may not be observed. Error count is not the number of lost entries.

evidence.title: Correlated open-operation span
metrics: Trace span with matching log / request identity
evidence.scope: Exact deployment target, log namespace and ID; mapped node/path for node metrics; reader identity where applicable.
evidence.preconditions: The source is reachable, the target series are present, and the selected window has enough valid samples.
evidence.rule: Show the span's actual interval and relationship when correlation is established. Treat it as supporting context.
evidence.limits: Missing sampling or broken propagation cannot establish that a step did not run; span names alone are not enough.
evidence.availability: Needs configured tracing and explicit correlation; exact span mapping must be verified.
evidence.owner: Existing independent source commands; exact per-log correlation/capture is not inferred

problems.title: Slow reads
problems.description: Inspect actual read branches and delivered data. Keep tail waiting separate from slow I/O.
path: Replica batch read / direct object read

problems.title: Slow writes
problems.description: Inspect each measured write interval separately, from Writer through replica persistence.

problems.title: Reads not advancing
problems.description: Establish readable backlog before labeling a waiting Reader as stalled.

problems.title: Writes not completing
problems.description: Check input activity, uncompleted work, acknowledgments and explicit service rejections.

problems.title: Open Reader fails
problems.description: Separate instrumented outcomes, timing and the exact error context.

problems.title: Open Writer fails
problems.description: Separate successful opens, lock errors and fencing errors before explaining the failure.

problems.title: Metadata checks
problems.description: Show current read-only records and existing wpcli findings. No new dynamic diagnosis.
